metadata.description: AI development tools - scaffolding, sidecar containers, and more

plugins.name: scaffold-project
plugins.description: Project scaffolding with standard dev configs (biome, ruff, vitest, pytest, cursor rules, claude hooks)

plugins.name: dev-workflow-tools
plugins.description: Common development tool skills, including progressive native macOS UI automation with Peekaboo CLI

plugins.name: sunstack-dev
plugins.description: Shared engineering practices, principles, language standards, research, debugging, docs, operations and presentation.

plugins.name: sunstack-workflow-v1
plugins.description: Frozen legacy v1 workflow: roles, orchestration, design, planning, implementation, review and handoffs. Requires sunstack-dev. Do not edit without explicit owner instruction.

plugins.name: sunstack-workflow-v2
plugins.description: Editable v2 workflow: four design skills, four roles, and agent management. Requires sunstack-dev. Does not replace frozen v1.

plugins.name: skill-authoring
plugins.description: Skill authoring for any repository: design skill changes, write their files, turn their standards into checked rules, review them with independent agents, and audit which skills to create, update, merge, or skip.

plugins.name: agent-router
plugins.description: Agent collaboration, shared message boards, wake-ups and scheduled workflows through Codex Router.

plugins.name: agentstudio
plugins.description: Use Agent Studio worktrees, pane messages, context and App commands from coding agents.
